# Pre-publish

**When to load:** Use when about to push, tag, release or publish code other people will run — 'ready to release', 'cut a release', 'before I push', 'pre-publish', 'is this safe to ship'. The ordered gate sequence: scope the diff, deterministic gates, an independent read-only sweep with every finding traced, docs and code gaps, hot-path timing, a clean re-run on the exact commit, then the cut. Carries the traps that green CI hides.

Load this **before** you push a release or publish, not after something ships wrong.
